journey.title: Inauguration of BMSCE ACM Student Chapter
journey.text: February 22: Officially launched with over 250 attendees, laying the foundation for innovation and collaboration.

journey.title: First Technical Event
journey.text: July 16: A talk on "AI/ML in Cognitive Science Applications" by Dr. G R Sinha marked our academic debut.

journey.title: Hack for Good
journey.text: August: A week-long national hackathon in collaboration with TechGig. 98 participants, ₹10,000 prize pool, and free Google Cloud access.

journey.title: DSA Mastery Program
journey.text: January–February: A month-long course on Data Structures and Algorithms with 33 learners, concluding with an Amazon guest lecture.

journey.title: Duo's Dash Series
journey.text: Three editions across three years, each with 100+ participants. Creative, AI-powered mini-games testing teamwork and logic.

journey.title: ACM India Chapter Summit 2024
journey.text: December: Co-hosted with RVCE, BMSCE led this national summit on Sustainable Computing with 350+ attendees.

journey.title: National Recognition: Emerging Chapter Award
journey.text: Recognized by ACM India for excellence, impact, and engagement across the country.

journey.title: ACM India Regional Coordination
journey.text: January to present: The ACM India Council entrusted the chapter with managing regional events across India.

journey.title: ACM Student Town Hall
journey.text: April: Hosted with ACM India, the first Town Hall spotlighted awards, funding, research, and student chapter achievements.

journey.title: 15 Days of Code
journey.text: April–May: Highest participation with 285 students solving coding problems daily in a leaderboard-based challenge.

journey.title: Hosted ACM ROCS 2025
journey.text: September: The first two-day edition of ACM India's Research Opportunities in Computer Science, with speakers from IISc, IBM, Google DeepMind, and TCS.

journey.title: Hosted the SIGMOD+PODS 2026 Workshop
journey.text: May: A pre-conference workshop with ACM India ahead of SIGMOD+PODS 2026 in Bengaluru, with talks and a panel on rethinking relational databases in the age of GenAI.
